name: geekist-architecture-skills
description: Eleven agent skills for clear writing, shared terminology and practical architecture, with actionable treatment of uncertainty. Informed by established frameworks and competing writing skills.

interface.shortDescription: Clear agent writing and consistent project meaning
interface.longDescription: Help agents produce useful implementation tasks, architecture decisions and technical documentation while preserving project meaning. Includes workflows for marketing and interface copy. Geekist draws on DDD, SKOS, Diátaxis and MADR, together with adapted practices from Humanizer and plain-language writing skills. Source-integrity checks and contextual editorial patterns support consistent writing across a project.
defaultPrompt: Establish the concepts and vocabulary in this repository.
Review this project explanation for clear prose and consistent meanings.
Write this technical explanation for engineering and business readers.
Turn this evidence gap into bounded next actions.
